content.what_it_is: MATLAB snapshot plotting script for the FUNWAVE-TVD rain_on_hills case. Loads dep.out from ../work/output/ (L2, L4), dx=dy=10.0 (L5-L6), meshgrid coordinates (L8-L10), 10x8 inch figure (L13-L16), plot window ax=[0 6550 0 1990] (L18). For snapshot files=[90:90] (L20): loads u_, v_, eta_, mask_ (L26-L29), masks eta and a depth copy where mask<1 (L30-L32; masking of u,v commented out L34-L35), computes speed uu=sqrt(u.^2+v.^2) (L37) and curl (L38), time label = files*20 s (L40). Panel 1 (subplot 211): filled contours of bed elevation -dep with levels [-12:0 0.1:0.1:8] (L47), caxis [-12 12] (L48), a bold black zero (shoreline) contour (L50), colorbar labeled 'depth (m)' (L51-L52). Panel 2 (subplot 212): pcolor of flow speed with caxis [0 3.0] (L59-L60), quiver of u,v subsampled every sk=5 points scaled sc=50 with autoscale off (L63-L65), colorbar 'flow speed (m/s)' (L67-L68), axis window (L75). After the loop, prints snap.jpg (L79).
unresolved: contour level vector [-12:0 0.1:0.1:8] (L47) concatenates integer levels -12..0 with the single value 0.1 (the expression 0.1:0.1:8 starts at 0.1 with step 0.1 but is written after a space inside brackets so it parses as [-12:0, 0.1:0.1:8], i.e. -12..0 then 0.1..8 by 0.1); whether the author intended asymmetric spacing above 0 is unstated
u and v are not masked (L34-L35 commented) unlike the movie sibling, so quiver draws vectors in dry cells
eta, vort, and the time label are computed but unused in the plots (L28, L38, L40, title commented L73)
file index 90 with 20 s interval implies t=1800 s; the interval is not verifiable from this file
